parsed.body:
import sys
import json

# Universe and sets
U = set(range(1, 10))
sets = {
    1: {1, 2, 3},
    2: {4, 5, 6},
    3: {7, 8, 9},
    4: {1, 4, 7},
    5: {2, 5, 8},
    6: {3, 6, 9},
    7: {1, 5, 9},
    8: {2, 6, 7},
    9: {3, 4, 8},
}

# Build dancing links structures (Algorithm X)
class Node:
    __slots__ = ('left','right','up','down','column','row_id')
    def __init__(self):
        self.left = self.right = self.up = self.down = self
        self.column = None
        self.row_id = None

class ColumnNode(Node):
    __slots__ = ('size','name')
    def __init__(self, name):
        super().__init__()
        self.size = 0
        self.name = name
        self.column = self

# Header
header = ColumnNode('header')
columns = {}
for elem in U:
    col = ColumnNode(elem)
    columns[elem] = col
    # link into header list (rightwards)
    col.right = header
    col.left = header.left
    header.left.right = col
    header.left = col

# Insert rows
row_nodes = {}
for r_id, elems in sets.items():
    first = None
    for e in elems:
        col = columns[e]
        node = Node()
        node.column = col
        node.row_id = r_id
        # vertical link
        node.down = col
        node.up = col.up
        col.up.down = node
        col.up = node
        col.size += 1
        # horizontal link
        if first is None:
            first = node
            node.right = node.left = node
        else:
            node.right = first
            node.left = first.left
            first.left.right = node
            first.left = node
    row_nodes[r_id] = first

solution = []
solutions = []

def cover(col):
    col.right.left = col.left
    col.left.right = col.right
    i = col.down
    while i != col:
        j = i.right
        while j != i:
            j.down.up = j.up
            j.up.down = j.down
            j.column.size -= 1
            j = j.right
        i = i.down

def uncover(col):
    i = col.up
    while i != col:
        j = i.left
        while j != i:
            j.column.size += 1
            j.down.up = j
            j.up.down = j
            j = j.left
        i = i.up
    col.right.left = col
    col.left.right = col

def search(k=0):
    if header.right == header:
        # all columns covered
        solutions.append([r for r in solution])
        return
    # choose column with smallest size
    c = header.right
    min_size = c.size
    col = c
    while c != header:
        if c.size < min_size:
            min_size = c.size
            col = c
        c = c.right
    cover(col)
    r = col.down
    while r != col:
        solution.append(r.row_id)
        j = r.right
        while j != r:
            cover(j.column)
            j = j.right
        search(k+1)
        # backtrack
        solution.pop()
        j = r.left
        while j != r:
            uncover(j.column)
            j = j.left
        r = r.down
    uncover(col)

search()

# Verification test
def verify(sol):
    covered = set()
    for r_id in sol:
        elems = sets[r_id]
        if covered & elems:
            return False
        covered |= elems
    return covered == U

all_ok = all(verify(sol) for sol in solutions)
print('Exact cover solutions found:', len(solutions))
for sol in solutions:
    print(sol)

# Witness output
witness = {
    "polarity": "positive",
    "evidence": {"path": "execution://witness"},
    "data": {"solutions": solutions}
}
print('WITNESS:', json.dumps(witness))
